issues.title: Roadmap isolation violation in crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md and phase instructions strictly forbid referencing roadmap files, phase numbers, or ./roadmap/ in code or comments. The codebase must remain coherent when roadmap/ is deleted.
issues.impact: Violates workspace policy and fails automated roadmap isolation audits; developer incorrectly claimed isolation check was clean.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:7: `//! continuous adapter over the shared §4.6 EMA engine (Phase-100090 ownership).`
issues.proposed_fix: Change line 7 of crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs to `//! continuous adapter over the shared §4.6 EMA engine.`

issues.title: Pre-admission database mutation in persona_observe_preference
issues.why_it_matters: When a candidate preference fails create-time admission, nothing should be written to the database. Currently, ensure_continuous_declaration commits the attribute schema before admission evaluates the candidate.
issues.impact: Unadmitted candidate keys permanently pollute attribute_schemas and are locked into continuous update_rule, blocking subsequent persona_put_stable discrete writes for those keys.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:120, 126-137: `ensure_continuous_declaration(args)?;` is executed before `run_create_admission(args)?;`. If admission returns rejected, the schema write is not rolled back.
issues.proposed_fix: Before admission in persona_observe_preference, only inspect if an existing schema is discrete (rejecting if so). Defer registration of new continuous schema until after run_create_admission passes.

issues.title: Discarded telemetry trend in PersonaEvent
issues.why_it_matters: PersonaEvent defines `pub trend: Option<f64>` documented as 'EMA trend after a continuous observe', but observe.rs emits `trend: None` on every observe.
issues.impact: Downstream telemetry sinks cannot monitor preference trend drift from PersonaEvent.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:198 hardcodes `trend: None`, despite line 147 computing `state.trend` via observe_continuous.
issues.proposed_fix: Pass `Some(state.trend)` to emit() in observe.rs and populate `trend: Some(trend)` on PersonaEvent.

issues.title: Missing finite check on PersonaPreference.trend
issues.why_it_matters: PersonaPreference::validate() checks `self.value.is_finite()`, but omits checking `self.trend.is_finite()`. Non-finite floats (NaN/Inf) can bypass domain validation.
issues.impact: Invalid float values could enter storage or downstream serialization.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-types/src/persona.rs:173-178 validates `self.value.is_finite()` but has no check for `self.trend.is_finite()`.
issues.proposed_fix: Add `if !self.trend.is_finite() { return Err(AmError::new(ErrorCode::OutOfRange, "persona preference trend must be a finite number")); }` in PersonaPreference::validate().

issues.title: Redundant partial index on persona_stable_entries in core schema
issues.why_it_matters: Both a non-unique index and a unique index exist on identical columns with identical predicate.
issues.impact: Wastes database storage and write I/O updating two identical indexes on every insert/update.
issues.evidence: sql/001_core.sql:315-322 defines both `persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_inx` and `persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_uix` on `(bank_id, attr_key) WHERE valid_until IS NULL`.
issues.proposed_fix: Drop the non-unique index `persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_inx` from sql/001_core.sql.

issues.title: Unnecessary KMS decryption overhead in find_preference
issues.why_it_matters: find_preference calls get_persona_document, which loads and decrypts all stable entries under KMS, even though preferences are stored unencrypted in a separate table.
issues.impact: Couples continuous observe performance and availability to KMS; a failure in KMS stable decryption causes continuous preference observe to fail.
issues.proposed_fix: Add a targeted query method to PersonaStore (e.g. `get_preference_state` or `has_preference`) that checks persona_preferences directly without decrypting stable entries.

issues.title: Dead/unimplemented read telemetry variants in PersonaEvent documentation
issues.why_it_matters: PersonaEvent documentation mentions `persona_get` operation and `read` outcome, but `PersonaGetArgs` has no telemetry sink and `persona_get` emits nothing.
issues.impact: Misleads API consumers into expecting telemetry on persona_get reads.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/lib.rs:73-78 documents `persona_get` and `read` on PersonaEvent, but crates/clio-persona/src/document.rs has no telemetry sink.
issues.proposed_fix: Update PersonaEvent documentation to indicate telemetry is mutator-only, or add PersonaVecSink to PersonaGetArgs if read auditing is required.

findings.title: Roadmap isolation violation: Phase-100090 referenced in code comments
findings.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:7: `//! continuous adapter over the shared §4.6 EMA engine (Phase-100090 ownership).`
findings.resolution: Removed '(Phase-100090 ownership)' from crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:7. Verified by grep over crates/ + sql/ (no roadmap/phase references).

findings.title: Pre-admission database mutation: ensure_continuous_declaration writes schema before admission evaluation
findings.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:120, 126-137: `ensure_continuous_declaration(args)?;` is executed before `run_create_admission(args)?;`. If admission rejects the candidate, `put_attribute_schema` was already committed to the database, contradicting the documented contract `/// The create path failed admission; nothing was written.` (crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:83) and permanently locking the unadmitted key to continuous update_rule, blocking subsequent `persona_put_stable` writes for that key.
findings.recommendation: In `persona_observe_preference`, only check whether the existing attribute schema is discrete prior to admission. Only register the continuous attribute declaration after `run_create_admission` passes.
findings.resolution: observe.rs: discrete-declared keys are now rejected via a read-only get_attribute_schema check before the gate; ensure_continuous_declaration(args, declared.as_ref()) is called only after run_create_admission passes (observe.rs:120-142). Test asserts a rejected create writes no attribute_schema row, so persona_put_stable stays usable for the key.

findings.title: Discarded telemetry trend: PersonaEvent.trend is hardcoded to None on continuous observations
findings.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:198: `PersonaEvent { ... trend: None, ... }` discards `state.trend` computed by `observe_continuous` (observe.rs:147), despite `PersonaEvent.trend` being documented in crates/clio-persona/src/lib.rs:91 as `/// EMA trend after a continuous observe.`
findings.recommendation: Pass `Some(state.trend)` into `emit` in `persona_observe_preference` and set `trend: Some(trend)` on `PersonaEvent`.
findings.resolution: emit() now takes a trend parameter and the observed path passes Some(state.trend) (observe.rs emit + call sites); observe_tests::t04 asserts persona_events trend == Some(0.85) and first-event trend is Some.

findings.title: Missing finite check on PersonaPreference.trend allows NaN/Inf values
findings.evidence: crates/clio-types/src/persona.rs:173-178: `PersonaPreference::validate()` validates `self.value.is_finite()`, but does not validate `self.trend.is_finite()`. If trend is non-finite, `validate()` succeeds and allows invalid float values into storage.
findings.recommendation: Add `if !self.trend.is_finite() { return Err(AmError::new(ErrorCode::OutOfRange, "persona preference trend must be a finite number")); }` to `PersonaPreference::validate()`.
findings.resolution: PersonaPreference::validate() rejects non-finite trend (NaN/Inf) with OutOfRange (crates/clio-types/src/persona.rs); clio-types persona_tests::scores_and_confidences_are_unit_bounded covers NaN and +Inf trend.

findings.title: Redundant partial index on persona_stable_entries in core schema
findings.evidence: sql/001_core.sql:315-322: `persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_inx` and `persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_uix` both index `(bank_id, attr_key) WHERE valid_until IS NULL`. The non-unique index is completely redundant with the unique index.
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant `persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_inx` index from sql/001_core.sql.
findings.resolution: Dropped persona_stable_entries_bank_id_attr_key_open_inx from sql/001_core.sql; the unique open-rows index is documented as doubling as the lookup index. Schema edited directly, no migration.

findings.title: Unnecessary KMS decryption overhead in find_preference during preference observation
findings.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/observe.rs:292-298: `find_preference` calls `store.get_persona_document(bank)`, which queries and decrypts all stable entries with KMS via `open_persona_value`, even though preferences are unencrypted numeric values in a separate table. A KMS failure or decryption error on stable entries causes continuous preference observation to fail.
findings.recommendation: Add a lightweight method to `PersonaStore` (e.g. `get_preference_state` or `has_preference`) that checks `persona_preferences` directly without querying or decrypting stable entries.
findings.resolution: Added PersonaStore::get_preference(bank, key) (trait + SQLite + Postgres impls); observe.rs reads the preference row directly instead of get_persona_document, so continuous observation no longer loads/decrypts stable entries under KMS. Contract assertions (exact row, missing-key None, cross-bank None) added to run_persona_suite (SQLite + Postgres).

findings.title: PersonaEvent defines persona_get and read operations that are never emitted
findings.evidence: crates/clio-persona/src/lib.rs:73-78: `PersonaEvent` documentation defines operation `persona_get` and outcome `read`. However, `PersonaGetArgs` in crates/clio-persona/src/document.rs has no telemetry sink parameter and `persona_get` never emits telemetry.
findings.recommendation: Either add telemetry emission to `persona_get` if read audit is required by FR-15, or update `PersonaEvent` documentation to reflect that telemetry is mutator-only.
findings.resolution: PersonaEvent docs updated in crates/clio-persona/src/lib.rs: telemetry is mutator-only ('persona_put_stable' | 'persona_observe_preference'); outcome list drops 'read'; persona_get emits nothing (documented). Read audit can be added later if FR-15 read auditing is ever required.
